name: Example: daily, weekly and monthly rollup
description: Every night counts yesterday's _internal events by sourcetype and appends them to so_example_daily_rollup.csv. On Mondays a weekly step sums the last 7 days from that lookup, and on the 1st a monthly step sums the month before. Both work from the run's scheduled time through $run.scheduled_time$.

steps.name: Daily events by sourcetype
steps.spl:
index=_internal
| stats count AS events BY sourcetype
| eval day=strftime(tonumber($run.scheduled_time$) - 86400, "%Y-%m-%d")

steps.name: Weekly rollup
steps.spl:
| inputlookup so_example_daily_rollup.csv
| where strptime(day, "%Y-%m-%d") >= relative_time(tonumber($run.scheduled_time$), "-7d@d")
| stats sum(events) AS events BY sourcetype
| eval week_ending=strftime(tonumber($run.scheduled_time$), "%Y-%m-%d")

steps.name: Monthly rollup
steps.spl:
| inputlookup so_example_daily_rollup.csv
| eval t=strptime(day, "%Y-%m-%d")
| where t >= relative_time(tonumber($run.scheduled_time$), "-1mon@mon") AND t < relative_time(tonumber($run.scheduled_time$), "@mon")
| stats sum(events) AS events BY sourcetype
